findings.passage: Many people in Wisconsin want to vote, and are eligible to vote, but have been dissuaded from doing so by our ID requirements, first implemented in 2016.
findings.note: Press release statement issued in his name on the day of the Assembly floor debate on the photo-ID constitutional amendment; he says the ID requirement keeps eligible people from voting. Posted by Urban Milwaukee from his office.

findings.passage: While you can technically get a no cost ID in Wisconsin, it’s still practically impossible for people who don’t have access to the proper documents, don’t understand the process, or can’t get where they need to obtain one.
findings.note: Same statement; he describes the free state ID as hard to obtain in practice.

findings.passage: Voter fraud is not a widespread problem in the State of Wisconsin and is so infrequent that it’s difficult to count.
findings.note: Same statement; he gives his view of how common voter fraud is and cites a figure from a research group.
